# DeedHound

> Sheriff Sales & Foreclosure Auctions. Free, unofficial lists of upcoming sheriff sales and foreclosure auctions compiled daily from lists published by county sheriffs and Kentucky master commissioners. Always verify with the official county source before bidding; not legal or financial advice.

## States

- [Ohio sheriff sales](https://deedhound.app/ohio/): 218 upcoming sales in 27 counties, data as of Nov 11, 2026 6:00 AM ET or later
- [Pennsylvania sheriff sales](https://deedhound.app/pennsylvania/): 1741 upcoming sales in 3 counties, data as of Nov 12, 2026 11:11 AM ET or later
- [Kentucky sheriff sales](https://deedhound.app/kentucky/): 76 upcoming sales in 2 counties, data as of Nov 12, 2026 12:10 PM ET or later
- [New Jersey sheriff sales](https://deedhound.app/new-jersey/): 1259 upcoming sales in 17 counties, data as of Nov 12, 2026 7:13 AM ET or later

## Guides

- [How Deal Check works](https://deedhound.app/deal-check/): how listings are graded Strong / Fair / Pass from published bids and official values
- [How to pay for a sheriff sale](https://deedhound.app/financing/)
